release_notes:
1. Fixed Empty item_list_id & item_list_name on select_item: Implemented universal 4-tier list resolution hierarchy across all storefront pages (Home Page featured, PDP related products, Cart cross-sell, and non-hydrated catalog fallback to backend category ORM).
2. Expanded view_item_list builders to index, prices-drop, new-products, and best-sales controllers.
3. Universal click delegation ensures select_item fires consistently across all themes and custom listings without DOM dependency.
